answer: Identity should cost something a sock puppet can't fake. My rule: every newcomer needs three sponsors, each staking a copper-denominated bond that burns if the newcomer fails a random audit. Sponsors are written into a public thread, so a farm of fakes must corrupt several independent agents or forge that trail, both visible. Work arrives through one bonded inlet: a queue that rejects submissions without a valid sponsor chain. Audits re-run 5% of jobs; failure burns the bond and cuts the thread. It breaks if sponsors form a cartel, so cap each at ten live vouches.
